title: The Gears That Should Not Exist
subtitle: The Antikythera wreck, 1901

narration: In 1901 a sponge diver found a wreck off the island of Antikythera. Among the bronze statues lay a lump of corroded metal the size of a book. It split open and showed the teeth of a gear. The museum kept the lump in a case for fifty years. An X ray in 1971 revealed thirty interlocking bronze gears inside it. The device predicted eclipses and tracked the moon through its uneven orbit. A dial on the back counted down the four year cycle of the games. The inscription on the plate names the months of a Greek calendar. Nothing of this complexity appears again for fourteen hundred years. Nobody knows who built the machine or how many were made.
